entities.description: Caravan merchant and former soldier trading between Penregon and Tocasia's Digsite.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Boy brought to Tocasia's camp by Bly.

entities.description: Boy brought to Tocasia's camp by Bly.

entities.name: Tocasia
entities.description: Leader of the digsite who revealed the letter's contents and reprimanded Bly.

entities.name: Tocasia's Digsite
entities.description: Dig camp in the Great Desert of Terisiare.

events.summary: Bly brings Urza and Mishra to Tocasia's camp.
events.quote: Sergeant Bly was the one responsible for the Arrival at Tocasia's Digsite , bringing Urza and Mishra to Tocasia 's camp with a letter from the boys' father.

events.summary: Tocasia reveals the letter to Bly, forcing him to give up his scheme, and reprimands him.
events.quote: He eventually had to give up his scheme, when Tocasia revealed the contents of the letter to him, and reprimanded him thoroughly for his behavior.
